title: Optimal bounds for the boundary control cost of one-dimensional fractional Schrödinger and heat equations
summary: We derive sharp bounds for the boundary control cost of the one-dimensional fractional Schrödinger and heat equations. The analysis of the lower bound is based on the study of the control cost of a related singular boundary control problem in finite time, using tools from complex analysis. The analysis of the upper bound relies on the moment method, involving estimates of the Fourier transform of a class of compactly supported functions.
